subject: Clarify virtual account remittance notes and VAT allocation
messages:
From: Jill Park <jill.park@acmeco.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 08:12:00 -0500
Subject: Remittance hit virtual account — invoice mapping

Hi Karthik,

We're reconciling incoming credits to your virtual account (VA: 800-338) and see two recent ACHs that were posted to a single invoice (Invoice 78921). Our bank reference shows 'VA-ACME-0326' on one payment and the other payment has no narrative on the wire. Could you confirm whether Redwood intended both receipts to be applied to 78921, or if one should be posted to a credit note / unapplied balance?

I've attached the customer's remittance file (Acme_Remittance_20260301.pdf) and our payment export. If you need a bank trace we can request it — just confirm the accounting references you'd like us to use. Also please advise on VAT treatment: one payment appears to be net of 20% VAT withholding at the payer level; we want to make sure your ledger reflects the correct tax split so we don't misstate the VAT reclaim.

Attachments: ACME_Remittance_20260301.pdf (remittance stub)

Thanks,
Jill Park
Manager, Accounts Payable
AcmeCo
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jill Park <jill.park@acmeco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Remittance hit virtual account — invoice mapping

Hi Jill — thanks for the note and the remittance. Looping in Laura and Vanessa from billing to help with the posting. A few quick asks so we can resolve this cleanly: 

- Can you confirm the originating bank's trace/ref (or a SWIFT UETR) for the second payment? If you can request a bank trace that would be ideal — please copy traces@acmebank.com if you submit it.
- If one payment was intended as a credit/advance, can you indicate the credit note number (or the customer reference) you expect us to apply it to?
- Confirm whether the payer withheld VAT (your note about 20%) and, if so, the withheld amount and whether AcmeCo will remit that VAT to local tax authorities or expects Redwood to reclaim. We typically post VAT per invoice line and need the exact split to generate the correct statement.

For transparency, our system will create a provisional allocation which we'll hold pending the bank trace. If the second payment is a separate settlement we can split it to: Invoice 78921 (EUR 12,450.00) and Credit Note 1023 (EUR 1,200.00). If that matches your records, reply with confirmation and the trace ID and we'll finalize the posting.

Attachments you sent: ACME_Remittance_20260301.pdf (included above)

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
